en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing two adjoining, pyramid‑shaped hills with a saddle between them, open meadows and scattered trees in the foreground. The reverse reads in Romanian and includes printed headings and a blue‑ink handwritten message and address. The print identifies the view as from Câmpulung‑Moldovenesc and names the feature "Muntele Adam și Eva." Postmarks show a 1958 date.
